title: Never Melting American Katsuobushi Hash
description: A rich, buttery American dish featuring katsuobushi and tempering chocolate, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Tempering Chocolate (Cocoa Nibs and Cocoa Powder)

instructions: Preheat the comal or a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, tempering chocolate, salt, and paprika.
Add the katsuobushi and whisk until combined.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in the comal or skillet. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the comal or skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the edges start to set.
Flip the patties and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat the process with the remaining batter, adding more butter as needed.
If using cheese, sprinkle on top of the hash and cook until melted.
